entities.summary: Edward Robert Hughes was a British painter, who primarily worked in watercolours, but also produced a number of oil paintings. He was influenced by his uncle and artist, Arthur Hughes who was associated with the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, and worked closely with one of the Brotherhood's founders, William Holman Hunt. Edward Robert Hughes was a painters & sculptors from London (1851-11-05, London–1914-04-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
